page_title: FRE 0-1 UNI | Freiburg v Union Berlin 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+13' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+13' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+12' A rebound falls kindly for Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
90+12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+11' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+10' Matheo Raab (Union Berlin) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+7' Matheo Raab (Union Berlin) picks up an injury.
90+6' A spell of possession for Freiburg in an attempt to control the game.
90+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg).
90+3' Yellow card! It's like Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Sven Jablonski agrees and books him.

90+2' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Noah Atubolu was helpless.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
87' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Livan Burcu will be replaced by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin).
86' A substitution has been made. Jordy Makengo goes off and Christian Gunter (Freiburg) comes on.
83' Freiburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
81' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
80' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Janik Haberer and he is replaced by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).

79' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' The attendance for today's match is 33200.
75' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

75' Matheo Raab doesn't have to worry about that one. Philipp Treu puts a cross in towards Igor Matanovic (Freiburg), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar.
73' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
72' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
70' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin have been awarded a free kick.
66' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
64' Here comes a substitution. Tim Skarke is given a rest as he is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
64' Here is a change. Ilyas Ansah is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
62' He should have scored! Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Holer.
60' Freiburg have a corner.
60' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
57' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
56' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
54' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
53' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Freiburg keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

49' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' The end of the first half.
45' Flag up against Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
44' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
43' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
42' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
39' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play.

37' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
36' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
35' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
32' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Freiburg.
32' A long pass finds Lucas Holer (Freiburg) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
32' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
29' Freiburg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
26' Half-chance! Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) plays a pass into the box, but Matheo Raab reacts well to snuff out the attack.
25' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Derry Scherhant (Freiburg), but the defence gets it clear.
23' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

22' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top right corner is blocked by Matheo Raab, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

21' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
21' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
18' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
18' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The game has begun to heat up. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
15' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
14' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and it's Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
12' The Freiburg players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
10' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
7' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
4' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

3' A sweet pass finds Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
1' The match has just started.
